_header.description: Pinned catalogue of 33 standard ontology marketplace packs (DEC-P07). Identity source: open-ontologies marketplace at 9e73d95 (36 entries).

excluded_language_bases.reason: owl, rdfs and rdf are RDF language bases, not domain vocabularies; they are excluded from the installable marketplace per DEC-P07.

pin_run.note: sha256 recorded from a single first fetch per entry; a later first-fetch mismatch is a hard error with a re-pin procedure (RISK-001) - never overwrite a pin to make a fetch pass.

_header.license_policy: license_source is 'pack-bytes' when the fetched pack declares its license, else 'publisher' for the publisher's documented license. Zero entries carry license-restricted terms (AC-016).
